programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.sub_title: Daniel And Jodi Like Different Things
programs.desc: When the class gets to make their own pizzas, Daniel assumes Prince Wednesday wants peppers, just like he does! Daniel learns that friends can like different things and that's okay.

programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: After quizzing Nim, The Makery helps her make a wax crayon crocodile, a truck drawing, a monster trifle, and a glittery pig game.

programs.title: Play School
programs.desc: Luke and Leah are painting flowers and learning about all things big and small in the garden! They cook carrot muffins for a garden picnic. In the big Play School pop-up book, we see a garden with lots of small critters.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Evie, Anthony, and Paloma the Mermaid are in the Wiggly Kitchen what will they find today? Sing along to 'This Old Man' then it's time to visit the Dancing Water Police of Wiggle Town to solve their problem.

programs.title: Thomas & Friends
programs.desc: When the Rickety Old Bridge collapses, trapping Toby and Henrietta on the other side of the ravine, Inventor Ruth is asked to build a new one.

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Today is Poppy's birthday! Miffy and Grunty then prepare a great gift: draw a pretty butterfly! The problem is that they don't know how to draw them...
